title: RNA extraction for Kryptoperidinium triquetrum and Nitzschia laevis
author: Will Lewis

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample aliquot and store the remainder.

substeps.instruction: Take a 50 µl aliquot into a sterile 1.5 mL tube suitable for use with a pestle grinder.
Store the remaining 250 µL sample at -20 °C.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using a pestle grinder.

substeps.instruction: Pestle grind the 50 µl sample for 1 minute.

steps.title: TRIzol Addition
steps.instruction: Add TRIzol to the lysed sample and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µl TRIzol to the lysed sample.
Mix by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Pellet cell fragments and collect supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new sterile tube.
Add 0.25 volumes of chloroform per volume of sample (measure sample volume using a pipette).
Thoroughly mix by vortexing for 15 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove the upper RNA-containing aqueous phase and transfer to a new sterile tube.
Avoid pipetting too close to the interface to prevent DNA contamination.
Note: Only small quantities of RNA are needed for RNA-seq; do not attempt to collect the total aqueous phase to maintain sample quality.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for column binding with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 0.6 volumes of ethanol to the aqueous phase.
Mix by gentle inversion.

steps.title: Column Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the Zymo-Spin IICR Column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the ethanol and aqueous phase mixture into a Zymo-Spin IICR Column in a Collection Tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Transfer the column into a new collection tube and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Pre-Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with Direct-zol RNA PreWash.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl Direct-zol RNA PreWash to the column.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Discard the flow-through and repeat this step.

steps.title: RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with RNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl RNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: On-Column DNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA using DNase I.

substeps.instruction: In an RNase-free tube, mix 5 μl DNase I (6 U/μl) and 75 μl DNA Digestion Buffer by gentle inversion.
Add the mix directly to the column matrix.
Incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Perform final wash to remove buffer and enzymes.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μl RNA Wash Buffer5 to the column.
Centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer the column carefully into an RNase-free tube.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μl of DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix.
Centrifuge to elute.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Analyze the purity and concentration of the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Analyze samples using Nanodrop to ensure the 260/280 ratio is ~2.0 and the 260/230 ratio is between 2.0 and 2.2.
Measure concentration of RNA and DNA using Qubit BR assay kits.
